o1.biggest_strength: Does the retention math itself and then builds the plan around it: creators and authors first, PH/HN last with little team time, plus a hard carry-over gate before the 1 Dec freeze. The X post and email are clean, on-voice and answer 'will my hotkeys survive' in the first line.
o1.biggest_mistake: The calendar is dense and a few lines are cramped (tables run long for the word budget), and the X post's 'Thank you' to authors is nice but thinner crediting than the reply-thread approach implies. The bolder two-wave idea is flagged as optional, which slightly muddies 'what has to be true.'
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Tighter prose, an explicit staged-update decision proposed up front rather than as a 'bolder move,' and name-check credit baked into the main post plus the first reply.

o2.biggest_strength: Crisp structure and the best go/no-go gate list: 1,000 real-setup updates, one-step undo for settings, top 200 extensions tested, measured speed claim with the Mac named, engineers joining support during freeze. The X thread and email are the most polished and on-voice of the two.
o2.biggest_mistake: 'At least 1,000 beta users update from their real setups' is a bar we cannot realistically prove with one launch manager and 9 creators in three weeks, and the plan schedules a beta email to 1,000 power users on 23 Nov with no stated capacity to support them. Also leans on brackets and measured-speed numbers that aren't in hand, so it reads slightly less ready as-is.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Replace the 1,000-user proof with a realistic test (staff plus author Macs plus 200 heavy users), fill the bracket placeholders with real picks/numbers, and confirm the engineering support shift dates.

reason: Both are strong and I would ship either. Output 1 wins on being closer to usable as-is, with the two-wave update framed as a real decision and no unproven 1,000-user gate; Output 2 has the better go/no-go list and the nicer thread, but asks for a beta proof we can't staff and leaves more placeholders to fill.
what_would_make_it_a_10: Combine Output 1's shippable drafts and honest gates with Output 2's 'undo + top 200 extensions + measured speed claim' checks, fill all placeholders, and decide the staged-update question with engineering by 20 Nov.
